## Pull Request Template

<!--
  Thanks for opening a pull request! Please take a moment to fill out the template
  so maintainers can review your changes quickly.
-->

### Summary
_A brief description of what this PR does and why it's needed._

### Related Issue
_Closes #__{number}__ or `_Fixes #__{number}__`

_If this PR resolves an issue, please link it above. Using `Closes #123` will automatically close the issue when the PR is merged (requires the branch to have the proper commit message, or GitHub will handle it on merge)._

### Type of Change
_Please delete options that don't apply:_

- [ ] **feat**: A new feature for the user
- [ ] **fix**: A bug fix for the user
- [ ] **docs**: Documentation only changes
- [ ] **refactor**: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] **test**: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
- [ ] **chore**: Changes to the build process or auxiliary tools/libraries
- [ ] **style**: Formatting, missing semi colons, etc; no code change impact
- [ ] **perf**: A change that improves performance
- [ ] **build**: Changes to build files, CI configuration
- [ ] **revert**: Reverts a previous commit

### Checklist
_Please check all items that apply. If you're unsure about any of them, don't worry — write in the "Additional notes" section and we'll help._

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines / linting rules
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, especially in complex or non-obvious areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added/updated documentation as needed
- [ ] I have updated the changelog (if applicable)
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass locally
- [ ] I have added tests to cover new functionality (if applicable)

### How Has This Been Tested?
_Describe the testing you performed to verify your changes. Include test commands, test names, or a brief description of manual testing._

### Screenshots / GIFs
_(If UI/UX changes, add screenshots or GIFs to show the before/after.)_

### Release Notes
_What should users see in the release notes for this change? (Leave blank if not applicable, or draft the note here.)_

### Additional Notes
_Anything else the reviewer should know? Feature flags, known caveats, temporary configs, etc._
